bet: Replacing Nelder-Mead with CMA-ES for all local refinement gives better handling of rotated landscapes and more robust convergence on f21's multi-modal structure

CMA-ES adapts to the hidden rotation and multimodality of f21 more effectively than fixed-step (1+1)-ES or grid-based Sobol+Nelder-Mead, leading to faster convergence and higher AOCC by maintaining a population that explores the landscape efficiently.
